checkedAlternates.risk: Retained earnings accumulate from net income.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Retained earnings is a cumulative Balance Sheet Shareholders’ Equity account (group-2), not a period flow on the Income Statement (group-4).

checkedAlternates.risk: Operating cash flow starts from net income or operating profit.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Operating Cash Flow is reported on the Statement of Cash Flows (group-1), not on the accrual-based Income Statement (group-4).
